test_title: PYST 45: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On : 31 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A coffee maker with a marked price of Rs. 4,500 is available on successive discounts of 20%, 10% and 5%. Find the selling price of the coffee maker.
solution:
**Given:**

The MP of the coffee maker = Rs. 4,500

Successive discounts of 20%, 10%, and 5%

**Formula Used:**

For successive discounts,

SP = MP × (100-D₁)/(100) × (100-D₂)/(100) × ... × (100-D_n)/(100)

**Solution:**

According to the question

SP = 4500 × (100-20)/(100) × (100-10)/(100) × (100-5)/(100)

⇒ SP = 4500 × (80)/(100) × (90)/(100) × (95)/(100) = Rs. 3078

**∴ The SP of the coffee maker is Rs. 3,078.**
